name: Yuza (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yuza town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Yuza, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 22 June 1970.

features.role: Yuza town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised mountain
